issues: tests/helpers.py FinTest.fail overrides unittest.TestCase.fail, and assertIn, assertNotIn, assertIsNone and the dict/list paths of assertEqual all report a failure through self.fail. A failing assertion therefore runs the CLI with the failure message as its arguments, gets exit 2 from argparse, and the test passes silently, so many assertions in the suite can never fail.

fin/tools.py parse_row calls core.check_period before the duplicate check in cmd_import, so re-importing a statement whose old rows fall in a closed month fails the whole import, even though those rows would only have been skipped as duplicates.

fin/api.py _execute repeats the transaction, rollback and schema-check logic of cli.run, and fin/core.py module_schemas imports billing, tools and reports from inside core, so the base layer depends on the feature modules; the schema is also split inconsistently (core holds the imported and cleared tables that tools and reports use).
